subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these revised third-party GitHub Action SHAs in credential-bearing CI workflows after upstream security review?
rationale: The patch changes code executed with App private keys, publishing credentials, and API keys; accepting that supply-chain trust boundary is a maintainer decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve reviewed revisions
options.body: Review the upstream release diffs and approve the final SHA-pinned action versions after a redacted successful trusted workflow run is attached.

options.title: Hold the grouped update
options.body: Keep the PR open until sensitive actions can be reviewed or split from lower-risk workflow dependency updates.

options.title: Close and regenerate narrowly
options.body: Close this grouped Dependabot PR and request separately reviewable updates for credential-bearing actions.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release diffs and approve the final SHA-pinned action versions after a redacted successful trusted workflow run is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies its prior review as the only concrete routing signal for this security-sensitive workflow surface.
